verdict.rationale: Context.dev's own docs say its Scrape endpoint returns a page as HTML (alongside Markdown and other formats) in a single request, and the SDK guides show scraping a webpage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the HTML returned is raw/unprocessed rather than cleaned, and independent or hands-on corroboration of HTML output quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back

citations.quote: Scrape a page into Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request.
Install the JavaScript and TypeScript SDK, scrape a webpage, and retrieve brand data.
